description: This file defines the TaskQueueInterface, which specifies the methods for queue operations in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, including checking if the queue is empty, adding tasks, and running tasks.

classes.name: TaskQueueInterface
classes.description: An interface for task queue implementations, outlining methods for queue management such as isEmpty, add, and run.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the task queue is empty.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a callable task to the queue to be executed later.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all pending tasks in the queue.
